nom: Pure Retinol Face Serum with Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) & Hyaluronic Acid

avis.titre: Yes, this really is as good as they say.
avis.texte: Took a sample to try out from a friend, was totally sold, got a bottle myself. I have fair, combination skin and live in a hot climate, so I use it all year long except for the four hottest months when the sun is the most active. Yes, even with SPF50 I could feel my face starting to burn while I was using this product, so I replaced it with a niacinamide serum for the symmer. So, what magic did it do? Well, the first few days it was horrid. I applied it onto clean skin, topped with light moisturizer, and went to bed. To say that my face got oily is to say nothing. It was practically a pancake. I had oil stains on my pillow for the first time in my life. Thankfully, I read about retinol and the way it works, so I kept using it and waiting to see what happens. After a few days, oil levels were back to normal. After 2 weeks I woke up to photoshopped skin. No, seriously. It’s never looked so good in my entire life. Smooth, blemish-free, unclogged pores, black dots almost completely gone. I wish I took before and after pictures. I had zero adverse reactions, my skin has no issues with retinol, which is great. Wish I could keep using it through the summer, but it’s just not worth the risk. So if you’re doubting whether this serum is worth the $$$ - yes, every single penny. I’ve had $100+ products that did nothing while this little gem just fixed my skin. I thought I’d just never be rid of those blemishes and bumps. Power to LRP&retinol!

avis.titre: Gentle, Effective and Great for Sensitive Skin!Gentle, Effective and Great for Sensitive Skin!
avis.texte: This was my very first retinol product, and I’m so glad I chose this one. I was a little nervous about trying retinol because I have sensitive skin, but this serum has been incredibly gentle and beginner-friendly. I started using it a few nights a week, and I didn’t experience the irritation or dryness that many people talk about with retinol products. The next morning, my skin feels soft, smooth, and refreshed. After several weeks of use, I noticed my complexion looks healthier, brighter, and much less dull than before. My skin has a nice glow, and it feels more hydrated and balanced overall. I also love that this serum contains niacinamide and hyaluronic acid, which help keep my skin moisturized while using retinol. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave any sticky residue behind. If you’re new to retinol or have sensitive skin and want to start incorporating an anti-aging product into your skincare routine, I highly recommend giving this serum a try. It has exceeded my expectations, and I will definitely be purchasing it again and again. One of the best skincare purchases I’ve made!

avis.titre: Consistent, visible results with gentle retinol
avis.texte: I’ve been using the La Roche-Posay Pure Retinol Face Serum for almost a year and the results have been genuinely impressive. Over time, I’ve noticed a visible improvement in skin texture, smoothness and overall radiance. Fine lines appear softer and my skin looks more refined and even-toned. I like that it's effective yet gentle. I have not experienced any irritation often associated with retinol products. The inclusion of Vitamin B3 adds a hydrating, soothing element, which makes it particularly suitable for sensitive skin. It absorbs well, layers easily into my routine and delivers consistent, long-term benefits rather than quick temporary results. It's a well-balanced retinol serum that delivers real anti-ageing results without compromising skin comfort. A staple in my skincare routine.

avis.titre: Light Fragrance - A little goes a long way
avis.texte: This is my second bottle of this serum. My original is not yet gone but, I bought a second for my travel bag. Can I say have noticeable results, no but, I did not take before and after but, I truly don’t notice anything. I just hope that I am doing my part to slow further aging. The formula has a slight fragrance which I think is pleasant. I do not have sensitivity to it. Sometimes strong floral fragrances give me headaches but, I am happy with this scent. It is almost a light perfume fragrance. It is a thicker formula (not watery) and this can go quickly if you don’t monitor application amounts. A little bit goes a long way. A third of a dropper is too much for me to cover face and neck. It does have a slick almost slimy feel when first applying (not tacky) but, rubs in easily and nicely. Overall I am pleased with the product. However, I will have to better monitor for results in order to keep purchasing at this price point. I purchased my first bottle in late November and it is currently early February. I use typically 3-4 days per week and I still have about a third or little less of the bottle.

Me ha ayudado con mis manchas y poros abiertos. La crema Mela-B3 de La Roche-Posay es un producto dermatológico diseñado para ayudar a reducir la aparición de manchas oscuras y hiperpigmentación en la piel. A continuación, te presento algunos detalles sobre este producto: *Ingredientes activos* 1. *Vitamina B3 (Niacinamida)*: Ayuda a reducir la aparición de manchas oscuras y a mejorar la textura de la piel. 2. *Ácido Kojico*: Ayuda a reducir la producción de melanina, lo que puede ayudar a reducir la aparición de manchas oscuras. 3. *Vitamina C*: Ayuda a proteger la piel del daño causado por los radicales libres y a mejorar la textura de la piel. *Beneficios* 1. *Reduce la aparición de manchas oscuras*: La crema Mela-B3 ayuda a reducir la aparición de manchas oscuras y a mejorar la uniformidad del tono de la piel. 2. *Mejora la textura de la piel*: La crema Mela-B3 ayuda a mejorar la textura de la piel, haciéndola más suave y radiante. 3. *Protege la piel del daño causado por los radicales libres*: La crema Mela-B3 contiene antioxidantes que ayudan a proteger la piel del daño causado por los radicales libres. *Precauciones y contraindicaciones* 1. *No se recomienda para piel sensible*: La crema Mela-B3 puede causar irritación o reacciones alérgicas en piel sensible. 2. *No se recomienda para embarazadas o lactantes*: La crema Mela-B3 puede tener efectos adversos en el feto o el bebé.

avis.titre: “Faded My Dark Spots and Evened Out My Skin Tone – Excellent Retinol!”
avis.texte: I’ve been using La Roche-Posay Retinol B3 for almost six months, and it has truly made a difference in my skin. The dark spots I had have noticeably faded, and my overall skin tone looks more even and radiant. What I really like is that even though I only use it once or twice a week at night, the results are still visible with consistency and care. This is an excellent product because it not only helps reduce pigmentation but also improves the texture of the skin, making it feel smoother and healthier. A very important tip: I never mix it with other active ingredients—only with my moisturizer after applying it. Used this way, it works effectively without irritation. Highly recommended for anyone looking to lighten dark spots and achieve a more uniform complexion!

avis.titre: Better looking skin, I had no irritation
avis.texte: I'm not new to using retin-A products, from over the counter available creams to prescription strength tretoinin prescribed by my dermatologist. I just always put up with the embarrassing redness and peeling because I was after the end results of smoother skin and improvement with fine lines and wrinkles. When I was given the opportunity to review La Roche-Posay's Pure Retinol B3 serum I was hopeful that it would be gentler on my skin and it is. The following is my experience with this serum. I used this serum at night as directed. Using the dropper and dispensing a few drops into my hand, I applied it to my face. It went on smoothly and was absorbed completely into my skin, leaving no sticky or tacky residue to the touch. What was immediately apparent is that my skin looked much smoother and hydrated upon application. I'm sure this has to do with the complex formulation as retin-a itself takes time to produce results over time. Still, I liked how my skin looked and felt. I experienced no irritation. I can't speak to the overall potency of this product as I could not find on the box nor label, the strength of the retin-a used in this La Roche-Posay's Retnol face serum. I'm familiar with the La Roche-Posay's name and to be honest shyed away from purchasing due to their prices. That being said however, I have noticed a glow and more plump look to my face since using this product and that in itself makes me feel the cost is justified. I can comfortably recommend this serum espec

avis.titre: Good Formula for Those Who Haven’t Tried/Used Retinol in a While
avis.texte: The Le Roche-Posay Retinol Face Serum is a good serum to use if you’re looking to smooth out your skin and remove fine wrinkles. I haven’t used Retinol in a few months now and after trying this for the first time, realized I needed to use less product to start off as I started quickly flaking in the days following. After easing off the serum, I used less under my daily moisturizer/sunscreen and have been pleased with the results. My skin has been looking healthier, smoother, and the wrinkles and freckles are slowly starting to fade away. This is a product that does take time and dedication as well as very liberal amounts of sunscreen applied. The serum is slightly liquidy and easy to applie. The dropper allows for precise control on how much you apply to your face and I’ve found that it worked well with my combo/dry skin. This formula has a lightly floral scent to it that quickly fades as it dries. Overall, if you’re looking for a lower concentration retinol to start off with, this is a good option to consider.

avis.titre: Moisturizes Well.  A Little Goes a Long Way.  Be Careful w/Sun Exposure.
avis.texte: I've been using this serum for about a week now. I apply it all over my face (careful to avoid eyes) at night after I wash. I don't need to use a whole lot. I place a few drops on my hand at a time (I only need to do this a couple times to cover my whole face and neck), so as not too use/waste too much. A little really does go a long ways. I noticed it does moisture nicely, w/o leaving any tacky/greasy feeling behind. I even used it on my forehead and it hasn't made it greasy at all. The serum dries and leaves my skin feeling soft. There is hardly any scent to speak of and this serum doesn't bother my skin AT all. Certain products can irritate my skin, but not this one. I did notice a warning on the bottle/box about sun sensitivity when using Retinol. Basically your skin will burn easier when left unprotected in the sun. This is pretty much the same with any Retinol product. Just use a mild sunscreen to alleviate this problem. Overall this serum seems to work nicely. I think that it's a bit pricey, but a lot of Retinol products are.

avis.titre: Made such a difference for me!
avis.texte: I gave this 5 stars because it is my favorite serum I have used, not because it is some magical fix all! I am 34 stay at home mom of 3 young kids and I don't often have the time or desire to put on a lot of makeup. I haven't always felt comfortable going out without makeup; however, I have been working on my skincare regimen and I have to say this had really made a noticeable difference! 1. I have sensitive skin and other serums have burned in the past. I have had no redness or burning sensations! 2. While this is not the most moisturizing, it does say specifically to use this alongside a mositurizer. I have found a great light moisturizer to use after this and the 2 products are the extent of my face care anymore!! 3. A little goes a long way. It isn't sticky and soaks in quickly so I don't feel like I'm wiping off/wasting any 4. The price for this is reasonable as some serums get so $$$!! I have used drug store to $150/bottle serums and this is my favorite. I now feel so great going out without makeup!!
